ui.levelDebDesc: Simple questions to ease into it.
ui.levelIntDesc: The standard level, to check what you've learned.
ui.levelAvaDesc: More precise questions, to go further.
ui.tierLow: Needs work! Reread the workshop sheet and try again.
ui.tierMid: Not bad! A few points still to work on.
ui.tierHigh: Excellent! You have a solid grasp of the topic.

debutant.q: How many operating systems are compared in Battle OS?
debutant.explain: Battle OS compares Windows, Linux and macOS.

debutant.q: Which of these words refers to an operating system?
debutant.explain: Windows, like Linux and macOS, is an operating system.

debutant.q: Can a computer run without any operating system?
debutant.explain: The operating system is essential for running a computer.

debutant.q: What free software replaces Microsoft Office, especially on Linux?
debutant.explain: LibreOffice is the free alternative to Microsoft Office.

intermediaire.q: Which system is 100% free and perfect for bringing an old PC back to life?
intermediaire.explain: Linux is free and runs PCs that Windows 11 refuses to install without any problem.

intermediaire.q: Which system largely dominates video games, with 95% of games available?
intermediaire.explain: Windows remains the undisputed benchmark for gaming (Steam, Xbox, Ubisoft, etc.).

intermediaire.q: Which system is known to collect almost no personal data?
intermediaire.explain: Linux is open source, auditable by anyone, with very little data collection.

intermediaire.q: Can macOS be legally installed on a classic PC (except Mac)?
options: No, it is reserved for Apple machines
Yes, via a simple USB key
intermediaire.explain: macOS is only officially available on Apple hardware.

intermediaire.q: To test Linux without installing anything on your hard drive, we use:
intermediaire.explain: Live mode from a USB key allows you to test Linux without modifying anything on the computer.

intermediaire.q: LibreOffice, the free alternative to Microsoft Office, allows you to open:
intermediaire.explain: LibreOffice is compatible with the most common Microsoft formats.

avance.q: The final score of "Battle OS" designates Linux champion with how many points over 6 rounds?
avance.explain: Linux won 11 points in the final scoreboard, ahead of Windows (8) and macOS (5).

avance.q: In which round does Windows win the most?
avance.explain: Windows absolutely dominates the Gaming round, with 95% of games available primarily on this OS.

avance.q: What technology allows many Windows games to run on Linux via Steam?
avance.explain: Proton, integrated into Steam, allows you to play many Windows games on Linux.

avance.q: To boot from a Live USB key, what key do you generally press at startup?
options: F12 (or F2 depending on the machines)
avance.explain: F12 or F2 at startup allows access to the startup menu to choose the USB key.

debutant.q: Phishing is an attempt to:
options: Steal information from you by pretending to be a trustworthy site
debutant.explain: Phishing aims to steal your information by imitating a trusted site or organization.

debutant.q: Do we have to give our password if an “advisor” asks us over the phone?
options: Yes, if the voice is kind
Yes, if we call back ourselves
debutant.explain: No legitimate advisor ever asks for your password over the phone.

debutant.q: A suspicious link received by SMS, you must:
debutant.explain: You should never click on a suspicious link received by SMS.

debutant.q: Bitwarden is an example of:
debutant.explain: Bitwarden is a free password manager, mentioned in the file.

intermediaire.q: What should you do if you receive a verification code by SMS that you did not request yourself?
options: Give it if we are asked nicely
Write it down on a post-it just in case.
intermediaire.explain: No bank or public service will ever ask you for this code: giving it is opening the door to a scam.

intermediaire.q: How do you recognize an official French public service site?
options: He always asks for a bank card
intermediaire.explain: A public service always ends with .gouv.fr.

intermediaire.q: Faced with a message that creates urgency (“account blocked within 24 hours”), the right reflex is:
options: Quickly click to fix the problem
Be wary: this is a classic scam technique
Forward the message to your contacts
intermediaire.explain: Pressure and threats are the classic signature of phishing scams.

intermediaire.q: Which tool best protects against phishing by ONLY filling in your credentials on the real site?
intermediaire.explain: A password manager recognizes the real site and refuses to fill in a fake site: this is a valuable warning signal.

intermediaire.q: If in doubt about a link received by message, it is better:
options: Type the address yourself in the browser
Open it on a loved one's phone
intermediaire.explain: Never use the link from a questionable message: type the official address yourself.

intermediaire.q: “Quishing” refers to a scam via:
intermediaire.explain: Quishing is phishing that uses a fraudulent QR code (received by message or stuck in the street).

avance.q: What is phishing done over the phone (voice call) called?
avance.explain: “Vishing” refers to phishing carried out by voice call (voice + phishing).

avance.q: In addition to Bitwarden, which double authentication application is cited in the sheet?
avance.explain: The sheet cites Google Authenticator and Microsoft Authenticator as two-factor authentication applications.

avance.q: VirusTotal is used to:
options: Scan a questionable link or file using several antiviruses at once
avance.explain: VirusTotal allows you to paste a link or drop a questionable file to analyze it with dozens of antiviruses.

avance.q: On a computer, which tool already integrated into Windows protects free against booby-trapped sites?
avance.explain: Microsoft Defender is already integrated into Windows and blocks booby-trapped sites and malicious attachments for free.

debutant.q: Cyberbullying happens:
options: Via digital tools (telephone, social networks, etc.)
debutant.explain: Cyberharassment is committed via digital tools: telephone, internet, social networks.

debutant.q: Should we keep evidence of online harassment?
debutant.explain: Keeping dated screenshots is essential for reporting or filing a complaint.

debutant.q: Pharos is used to signal:
debutant.explain: Pharos (internet-signalement.gouv.fr) is the official platform for reporting illegal content.

intermediaire.q: To be considered cyberharassment, the acts must be:
intermediaire.explain: Cyberbullying is defined by repetition and the intention to harm, not by a simple isolated slip-up.

intermediaire.q: What is the free and anonymous number to report digital violence in France?
intermediaire.explain: 3018 is the national number dedicated to digital violence, free and anonymous, 7 days a week.

intermediaire.q: If I am a victim, the first recommended reflex is:
options: Do not respond and keep calm
intermediaire.explain: Responding can make the situation worse; calm and silence in front of the author are recommended in the first place.

intermediaire.q: Before blocking a harasser, you must first:
options: Report it to the police only
intermediaire.explain: Dated screenshots are essential for subsequent reporting or complaints.

intermediaire.q: If I simply witness cyberharassment, I must:
options: Share the message to alert everyone
Do not relay, and support the victim privately
Doing nothing is none of my business
Reply to the author to defend him
intermediaire.explain: Relaying amplifies harassment; the right reflex is to support the victim and report.

intermediaire.q: Cyberharassment of a victim under the age of 15 is punishable up to:
options: 3 years in prison and 45,000 euros fine
intermediaire.explain: The law provides for increased penalties (up to 3 years and 45,000 euros, or even more depending on the circumstances) when the victim is under 15 years old.

avance.q: According to the figures cited, what percentage of cases of cyberharassment take place on social networks?
avance.explain: 80% of cases of cyberharassment take place on social networks, according to the figures cited.

avance.q: Compared to an adult victim, does a victim under 15 benefit from an aggravated sentence?
options: Yes, the law provides for increased penalties for minors under the age of 15.
There is no expected age difference
Only for minors under 10 years old
avance.explain: The law provides for heavier penalties when the victim is under 15 years old.

avance.q: Number 119 specifically concerns:
avance.explain: 119 is the number dedicated to children in danger (3018 covers cyberbullying, 3114 suicide prevention).

debutant.q: Digital identity is:
options: All the traces you leave on the Internet
debutant.explain: Digital identity brings together all the traces, data and representations left on the Internet.

debutant.q: “Googling” means:
options: Typing your own name into a search engine
debutant.explain: Googling means searching for your own name to see what appears online about you.

debutant.q: E-reputation is important in particular for:
options: Your image among recruiters and your loved ones
debutant.explain: 92% of recruiters check online presence: e-reputation concerns everyone.

intermediaire.q: What percentage of recruiters check candidates’ online presence?
intermediaire.explain: 92% of recruiters check the online presence of candidates before receiving them.

intermediaire.q: The “calculated” identity is:
intermediaire.explain: Computed identity is the inferences made by algorithms from your online behavior.

intermediaire.q: The right to be forgotten (GDPR) allows you to:
options: Request dereferencing of content concerning you
Prevent people from talking about you
intermediaire.explain: The right to be forgotten allows you to request the delisting of certain content concerning you from search engines.

intermediaire.q: When faced with negative content about yourself online, the best practice is to:
options: Delete it by denying it publicly
Create a fake profile to defend yourself
intermediaire.explain: A quick, calm and factual response is the best crisis management in e-reputation.

intermediaire.q: A tool like Google Alerts is used to:
options: Be notified when people talk about you online
intermediaire.explain: Google Alerts sends an alert whenever your name (or a chosen word) appears online.

intermediaire.q: What should you do first to audit your online presence?
intermediaire.explain: Googling yourself is the first step to knowing what is visible about you.

avance.q: The “declarative” identity corresponds to:
options: What you say about yourself (profiles, publications)
avance.explain: Declarative identity is what you yourself say about yourself, via your profiles and publications.

avance.q: LinkedIn, About.me and Namechk are cited in the sheet as tools for:
avance.explain: These tools are cited in the “personal branding” category to build your online image.

avance.q: Among the 4 steps to building a positive e-reputation cited, which comes in 3rd position?
avance.explain: The order given is: audit, optimize your profiles, produce valuable content, then start the conversation.

debutant.q: Firefox and Brave are examples of:
debutant.explain: Firefox and Brave are privacy-friendly web browsers.

debutant.q: On an unknown site, before entering a password, you must check:
options: That the address is the correct one and the site is secure
debutant.explain: Always check the site address and security before entering any credentials.

debutant.q: DuckDuckGo is mainly used to:
debutant.explain: DuckDuckGo is a search engine that does not track its users.

intermediaire.q: A good password should be:
options: The same everywhere to remember it
Unique per site and randomly generated
intermediaire.explain: A unique, random password per site limits damage in the event of a data leak on a single service.

intermediaire.q: Among the double authentication (2FA) methods, the most vulnerable is:
intermediaire.explain: SMS is vulnerable to “SIM swap” (sim card theft), unlike a TOTP app or a physical key.

intermediaire.q: On public Wi-Fi, it is recommended to use:
intermediaire.explain: A trusted VPN encrypts your connection, essential on unsecured public Wi-Fi.

intermediaire.q: A typical example of a phishing domain (fake site) is:
options: amaz0n.fr (with a zero in place of the o)
intermediaire.explain: Fake sites often imitate the official address with small variations (letters replaced by numbers, etc.).

intermediaire.q: To store your passwords securely, you use:
intermediaire.explain: An encrypted password manager stores and generates unique, strong passwords for each site.

intermediaire.q: DuckDuckGo is an example of:
intermediaire.explain: DuckDuckGo, like Startpage or Brave Search, does not track your searches unlike Google.

avance.q: What setting protects data on a computer even if it is stolen?
avance.explain: Full disk encryption (BitLocker on Windows, FileVault on macOS) protects data in the event of theft.

avance.q: NextDNS and Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, cited in the sheet, are examples of:
avance.explain: NextDNS and Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 are encrypted DNS services recommended in the Advanced Action Plan.

avance.q: In the "advanced" action plan of the sheet, which tool is recommended for the most sensitive navigation?
avance.explain: Tor is recommended in the Advanced Action Plan for the most sensitive browsing.

debutant.q: Parental control is used in particular to:
options: Limit screen time and filter certain content
debutant.explain: Parental controls limit screen time, filter adult content and set schedules.

debutant.q: Should you punish your child without discussion if there is a problem online?
options: Yes, it is the most effective
debutant.explain: Dialogue without punishment is the good reflex recommended in the sheet.

debutant.q: Microsoft Family Safety works on which platform?
debutant.explain: Microsoft Family Safety controls PC and Xbox console: playtime, sites and reports.

intermediaire.q: Parental control is above all:
intermediaire.explain: Parental control accompanies the dialogue with the child, it never replaces it.

intermediaire.q: Where is it advisable to keep screens at home?
options: Always turned off and put away
intermediaire.explain: Keeping screens in common areas facilitates supervision and dialogue.

intermediaire.q: Qwant Junior is:
options: A search engine for 6-12 year olds
intermediaire.explain: Qwant Junior is a French search engine that blocks violence, pornography and advertisements for children.

intermediaire.q: The national number for “Childhood in danger” is:
intermediaire.explain: 119 is the free and anonymous national number dedicated to children in danger.

intermediaire.q: Google Family Link allows you to:
options: Limit screen time and locate Android device
Block the Internet completely and permanently
intermediaire.explain: Family Link allows you to limit screen time, validate applications and locate the child's device.

intermediaire.q: If in doubt about what your child is experiencing online, you should:
options: Dialogue without punishing and preserving evidence
intermediaire.explain: Dialogue without punishment and the preservation of evidence allow effective action if necessary.

avance.q: cybermalveillance.gouv.fr offers in particular:
options: Help and trusted providers near you
avance.explain: cybermalveillance.gouv.fr helps find assistance and trusted providers in the event of a problem.

avance.q: What is the indicative age range targeted by Qwant Junior?
avance.explain: Qwant Junior is a French search engine designed for 6-12 year olds.

debutant.q: ants.gouv.fr allows you to make a request for:
debutant.explain: ants.gouv.fr allows you to manage identity cards, passports, driving licenses and vehicle registration documents.

debutant.q: How many official sites exist for these procedures?
options: None, everything is done at the town hall
debutant.explain: There is only one official website: ants.gouv.fr.

intermediaire.q: What is the only official site for identity cards, passports, licenses and vehicle registration documents?
intermediaire.explain: ants.gouv.fr is the only official site of the National Agency for Secure Titles.

intermediaire.q: Take the procedure on the official website:
options: Costs nothing more than the title itself
Is always payable in addition to the tax
Requires a prior appointment at the town hall
intermediaire.explain: The official site does not charge any additional application fees: you only pay for the title (e.g. the registration fee).

intermediaire.q: If you are asked for your password by “official” email or SMS:
options: It's normal, you have to give it
This is a scam, never respond
You must call the police immediately
You have to pay to check
intermediaire.explain: No agent, no email, no official SMS ever asks for your password or bank card code.

intermediaire.q: A fraudulent site that imitates ants.gouv.fr is often recognized because it:
intermediaire.explain: Fake sites imitate the official appearance but charge an unwarranted premium.

intermediaire.q: The gray card concerns:
intermediaire.explain: The gray card (registration certificate) concerns vehicles: purchase, sale, change of address.

avance.q: What does the acronym ANTS mean behind ants.gouv.fr?
options: National Agency for Tourism and Sports
avance.explain: ANTS stands for National Agency for Secured Titles.

debutant.q: How many pages maximum should a CV be, according to the form?
debutant.explain: The CV must be 1 page maximum, even without professional experience.

debutant.q: Which free tool is recommended for easily creating your CV?
debutant.explain: Canva is the recommended free tool for creating a clean, readable resume.

debutant.q: A CV should preferably be sent in the format:
debutant.explain: The PDF format keeps the layout intact, regardless of the recipient's computer.

intermediaire.q: What file format should you use to send your CV?
intermediaire.explain: PDF ensures that the layout remains the same regardless of which computer opens it.

intermediaire.q: A CV must not exceed:
intermediaire.explain: A CV fits on a single page, even without professional experience.

intermediaire.q: The recommended CV file name is something like this:
intermediaire.explain: A clear file name (First Name_Last Name_CV.pdf) makes sorting easier for the recruiter.

intermediaire.q: The cover letter must be:
intermediaire.explain: A copied and pasted letter is immediately recognizable; it must always be personalized.

intermediaire.q: After how many days without a response is it advisable to follow up politely?
intermediaire.explain: A polite follow-up after 7-10 days is the recommended reasonable time frame.

intermediaire.q: On which free site can you easily create a CV online?
intermediaire.explain: Canva offers free resume templates that are easy to customize and export to PDF.

avance.q: Among the essential sections of the CV cited in the sheet, which is NOT one of it?
avance.explain: The sections cited are Header, Profile, Experience, Training and Skills — criminal record is not one of them.

avance.q: The complete application file may include, in addition to the CV and the letter:
avance.explain: The sheet cites the portfolio/links and diplomas/certificates as possible additional documents.

debutant.q: The CPF means:
debutant.explain: CPF stands for Personal Training Account.

debutant.q: Is the official CPF website free to consult?
options: No, you have to pay a subscription
debutant.explain: moncompteformation.gouv.fr is free and accessible to all those who have worked.

intermediaire.q: The CPF (Personal Training Account) is credited:
intermediaire.explain: The CPF is filled each year in euros as long as you work (up to a ceiling).

intermediaire.q: The official site to consult your CPF rights is:
intermediaire.explain: moncompteformation.gouv.fr is the only official website for the Personal Training Account.

intermediaire.q: The CPF can finance:
intermediaire.explain: The CPF finances certification training, the B permit, a skills assessment, the VAE, etc.

intermediaire.q: A typical sign of a CPF scam is:
options: A call that puts pressure “before your rights expire”
An appointment at a France Travail agency
intermediaire.explain: The CPF never approaches by telephone or SMS: this is the classic sign of a scam.

intermediaire.q: Does the CPF approach by telephone or SMS?
options: Only at the end of the year
intermediaire.explain: The CPF never approaches by telephone or SMS: in the event of a call, you must hang up and be wary.

avance.q: What is the annual CPF ceiling for a person whose level is below the CAP, or who has a disability?
avance.explain: The annual ceiling is €800 for a level below the CAP or with a disability, compared to €500 for others.

avance.q: The fixed contribution of €150 to the CPF concerns:
options: Certain audiences, with exemptions (e.g. job seekers)
avance.explain: Several groups are exempt from this participation, in particular job seekers registered with France Travail.

debutant.q: IA is the abbreviation of:
debutant.explain: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence.

debutant.q: ChatGPT is an example of:
debutant.explain: ChatGPT is a conversational AI assistant (chatbot).

debutant.q: Can an AI make mistakes while still appearing confident?
options: Yes, that's what we call a hallucination
debutant.explain: AI can confidently generate false information: this is called hallucination.

intermediaire.q: Does generative AI “understand” the world like a human?
options: No, it predicts the most likely word or pixel
It only depends on the model
intermediaire.explain: Generative AI doesn't "understand": it statistically predicts what is likely to come next, based on what it has learned.

intermediaire.q: When an AI confidently invents false information, we call it:
intermediaire.explain: We speak of “hallucination” when an AI invents a fact or a source in a plausible but false way.

intermediaire.q: According to the European Parliament (AI Act), 100% AI-generated content without creative human intervention is:
options: Not protectable under the current state of the law
intermediaire.explain: In France, a work is only protected if it bears the imprint of the personality of a human author.

intermediaire.q: What should you avoid entering into an AI chatbot without explicit consent?
intermediaire.explain: You should never enter health data, origin or opinions into a chatbot without clear necessity and explicit consent.

intermediaire.q: An AI agent, unlike a simple chatbot:
options: Plan and execute a sequence of actions alone
intermediaire.explain: An AI agent plans and executes actions to achieve a goal, without validation at each step.

intermediaire.q: Among these AIs, which one is French and hosted in France/EU?
intermediaire.explain: Le Chat, developed by Mistral AI, is hosted in France/EU, unlike most of the other AIs mentioned.

avance.q: According to the figures cited, the global electricity consumption of data centers for AI in 2024 is approximately:
avance.explain: 415 TWh in 2024, or almost the total annual electricity consumption of France (449 TWh).

avance.q: Gartner predicts that by 2028, what percentage of enterprise applications will incorporate agentic AI?
avance.explain: Gartner forecasts 33% by 2028, compared to less than 1% in 2024.

avance.q: How much would it cost to train a large model like GPT-4, according to the benchmark cited?
avance.explain: Training a large model would cost more than $100 million, for several thousand MWh consumed.

debutant.q: The “outside package” is:
options: What is included in the package
What you consume in addition to the package
debutant.explain: The extra package corresponds to what is consumed in addition to the subscribed package.

debutant.q: TTC means:
debutant.explain: TTC means All Taxes Included.

intermediaire.q: In France, the VAT rate applied to a mobile plan is:
intermediaire.explain: The standard VAT in France, applied to mobile plans, is 20%.

intermediaire.q: The “inclusive of tax” price corresponds to:
options: The price of the extra package only
intermediaire.explain: TTC means “All Taxes Included”: this is the price actually paid.

intermediaire.q: “Roaming” refers to:
intermediaire.explain: Roaming corresponds to using your phone outside your country of origin.

intermediaire.q: In the event of a dispute over your invoice, you must first contact:
options: Its operator, then the telecoms mediator if necessary
intermediaire.explain: You must first turn to your operator, then the electronic communications mediator in the event of persistent disagreement.

intermediaire.q: What should you check first when receiving your invoice?
options: The total amount and additional paid options
intermediaire.explain: The total amount and the lines in addition to the package (outside the package, options, roaming) are the first points to check.

avance.q: Which official site should you turn to as a last resort in the event of an unresolved dispute with your operator?
avance.explain: The electronic communications mediator (mediation-telecom.org) intervenes after the operator in the event of an unresolved dispute.

debutant.q: To take a screenshot on a smartphone, we generally use:
options: The Volume button + the side button
debutant.explain: The Volume + side button (or Power) combination allows you to take a screenshot.

debutant.q: To turn off a smartphone, you generally hold down:
debutant.explain: We hold the Power button then slide to turn off the device.

debutant.q: What number do we dial for firefighters in France?
debutant.explain: 18 is the fire service number in France (112 also works everywhere in Europe).

intermediaire.q: The European emergency number, valid everywhere even without a PIN code, is:
intermediaire.explain: 112 works throughout Europe, even without a PIN code or usual network.

intermediaire.q: To call emergency help without unlocking the phone, you can:
intermediaire.explain: Pressing the power button 5 times triggers the SOS call to 112 on most smartphones.

intermediaire.q: The code *#06# allows you to display:
options: The IMEI, unique number of the device
intermediaire.explain: *#06# displays the IMEI, the unique identifier of the device, useful in the event of theft or loss.

intermediaire.q: To preserve the battery over time, it is recommended to:
options: Always leave it at 100% at night
intermediaire.explain: Keeping the charge between 20% and 80% preserves battery life.

intermediaire.q: A good PIN code must:
options: Make at least 6 digits and never be 123456
Be written on the back of the phone
Be identical to that of the bank card
intermediaire.explain: A non-obvious PIN of at least 6 digits effectively protects the device.

intermediaire.q: Applications should only be installed from:
options: The official App Store or Google Play
intermediaire.explain: Official stores (App Store, Google Play) verify applications before publication, unlike external links.

avance.q: Which codes should be avoided because they modify settings, according to the form?
options: There is no code to avoid
avance.explain: The sheet indicates to avoid ##7780## and ##002#, which modify settings, unlike *#06# (IMEI) which is without risk.

avance.q: The code *#*#4636#*#* displays in particular:
options: The PIN code of the SIM card
avance.explain: *#*#4636#*#* provides access to battery and network information on Android.

debutant.q: Computer storage (HDD/SSD/NVMe) is used to:
debutant.explain: Storage retains data permanently, unlike RAM which is volatile.

debutant.q: The power supply of a computer is used to:
options: Supply electrical energy to the components
debutant.explain: The power supply converts electrical current to provide the necessary energy to all components.

intermediaire.q: The motherboard is primarily used to:
options: Connect and communicate all the components with each other
intermediaire.explain: The motherboard is the “conductor” that connects CPU, RAM, storage and peripherals.

intermediaire.q: The CPU (processor) is often compared to:
intermediaire.explain: The CPU executes instructions and performs calculations: it is the brain of the computer.

intermediaire.q: RAM (random access memory) is:
options: Volatile: its contents are erased each time it is turned off
intermediaire.explain: Unlike storage, RAM is volatile: it loses its contents as soon as the computer turns off.

intermediaire.q: To recognize a DDR4 strip without a label, we mainly look at:
options: The number of pins and the shape of the connector
intermediaire.explain: The number of pins and the position of the connector notch help identify the generation of RAM.

intermediaire.q: The processor socket determines:
options: Compatibility with a specific family of processors
intermediaire.explain: Each socket (e.g. LGA1700, AM5) only accepts a specific family of processors.

avance.q: A dedicated graphics card generally plugs into what type of connector on the motherboard?
avance.explain: Dedicated graphics cards plug into a PCIe slot on the motherboard.

avance.q: How many pins does a DDR4 RAM stick have?
avance.explain: DDR4 has 288 pins, with a slightly curved connector edge, like DDR5.

debutant.q: The site/app to manage your CAF file is called:
options: caf.fr and the “Caf – My Account” app
debutant.explain: caf.fr and the “Caf – My Account” application allow you to manage your file online.

debutant.q: Do I have to declare a change in situation (moving, birth) to the CAF?
debutant.explain: Any change in situation must be declared immediately on your CAF account.

intermediaire.q: On the CAF online account, you can:
options: Track your payments and download a certificate
intermediaire.explain: The CAF account allows you to track your payments, download certificates, declare changes, etc.

intermediaire.q: The quarterly declaration on the CAF website serves to:
intermediaire.explain: The quarterly declaration allows you to update your situation (income, activity) every three months.

intermediaire.q: In the event of a change in situation (moving, birth, etc.), you must:
options: Wait for the next paper mail
Declare it directly on your CAF account
Do nothing, CAF automatically knows it
intermediaire.explain: Any change in situation must be declared immediately in your CAF personal space.

avance.q: How many different approaches are explained step by step in the workshop?
avance.explain: The workshop details 12 procedures explained step by step, from the summary to safety and troubleshooting.

debutant.q: On which document can you find your 13-digit tax number?
debutant.explain: The 13-digit tax number can be found at the top of the latest tax notice.

debutant.q: Does it pay to file your taxes online?
debutant.explain: Declaring online at impots.gouv.fr is completely free.

intermediaire.q: The official website for filing taxes online is:
intermediaire.explain: impots.gouv.fr is the only official website of the Directorate General of Public Finances.

intermediaire.q: The new name of the personal tax space is:
intermediaire.explain: “My Public Finance space” is the new name of the old “private space”.

intermediaire.q: To log in for the first time, you must:
intermediaire.explain: The 13-digit tax number, indicated on the last notice, is necessary for the first connection.

intermediaire.q: Declare your taxes online, compared to paper:
intermediaire.explain: The online declaration deadline is generally later than that of the paper declaration.

intermediaire.q: Faced with a suspicious email claiming to come from taxes with a payment link, the right reflex is to:
options: Click on the link to check
Type impots.gouv.fr yourself into the browser
intermediaire.explain: Taxes never require payment by message: you must always type the official address yourself.

avance.q: In addition to the tax number, what other identifiers are necessary for a first connection?
options: Online access number and reference tax income
avance.explain: For the first connection, you need the tax number, the online access number, and the reference tax income.

debutant.q: The Vitale card is used to:
options: Certify your rights to Health Insurance
debutant.explain: The Vitale card certifies your rights to Health Insurance and facilitates reimbursement of care.

debutant.q: The Ameli account allows you to see:
debutant.explain: The Ameli account allows you to see what Social Security has reimbursed, and when.

intermediaire.q: The Ameli account and “My health space” are:
options: Two different sites, with different roles
intermediaire.explain: assure.ameli.fr (administrative) and monespacesante.fr (medical) are two very distinct sites.

intermediaire.q: assure.ameli.fr mainly concerns:
intermediaire.explain: The Ameli account manages the administrative side: reimbursements, certificates, Vitale card.

intermediaire.q: The Social Security number includes:
intermediaire.explain: The Social Security number has 15 digits and begins with 1 (man) or 2 (woman).

intermediaire.q: monespacesante.fr allows you to consult:
intermediaire.explain: My health space brings together the medical file: prescriptions, analysis results, vaccination record.

intermediaire.q: On the Ameli account, you can download:
intermediaire.explain: The certificate of rights, proving your rights to Health Insurance, can be downloaded in 2 clicks on the Ameli account.

avance.q: How many different ways to access your Ameli account are presented in the workshop?
avance.explain: The workshop presents 3 ways to access your Ameli account.

debutant.q: FranceConnect allows you to:
options: Log in to several public services with an existing account
debutant.explain: FranceConnect lets you log in to several public services using an account you already have.

debutant.q: Does the pension arrive automatically in the account when the time comes?
options: No, you have to apply for it
Yes, but with a year's delay
debutant.explain: Retirement must be applied for: it doesn't arrive automatically.

intermediaire.q: The official website that brings together all pension schemes is:
intermediaire.explain: info-retraite.fr brings together all your pension schemes in one place.

intermediaire.q: To log in to info-retraite.fr, you use:
options: A code received by mail only
intermediaire.explain: FranceConnect lets you log in with an account you already have (taxes, Ameli...), without a new password.

intermediaire.q: Applying for retirement online:
intermediaire.explain: The retirement application is always free; a site that asks for money is a scam.

intermediaire.q: It is recommended to submit your retirement application:
options: On the very day of the desired departure
About 4 months before the departure date
intermediaire.explain: It is recommended to submit your application about 4 months before the desired departure date.

intermediaire.q: A site that asks for money to "handle your retirement for you" is:
intermediaire.explain: Applying for retirement is always free: any site that demands money is a scam.

avance.q: For a civil servant, which additional document is mentioned to finalize the file on ensap.gouv.fr?
options: Certificate of removal from staff register
avance.explain: For a civil servant, the certificate of removal from staff register is finalized on ensap.gouv.fr (the certificate of cessation of activity applies to self-employed people).
